services.label: Services
services.heading: Five ways we set the pace

items.title: Paid media buying
items.description: Full-funnel campaign management across every major platform. We plan, launch, test, and scale — obsessing over creative, audiences, and ROAS so you don't have to.

items.title: Email & SMS
items.description: The highest-margin revenue channel you're probably underusing. Flows, campaigns, and list growth that turned into $250K for one client last year.

items.title: Growth consulting
items.description: Already have a team? We'll audit your account, fix what's leaking, and build the strategy. Senior-level thinking without the agency retainer.
items.tags: Account audits · Growth strategy · In-house training · Forecasting

items.title: Creative production
items.description: The creative is the targeting. We produce the ads, content, and campaign assets that stop thumbs and convert — built for the platforms they run on.

story.label: Our motto
story.statement: We have a small dinner table — doesn't mean we don't want you to eat.
story.statementMuted: A boutique roster, on purpose. Fewer clients, more attention, everybody eats.

process.label: Process
process.heading: From first call to first win

steps.title: Audit
steps.description: We tear down your ad accounts, email flows, and funnel. You get a written breakdown of what's working, what's leaking, and what it's costing you.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Strategy, creative direction, tracking, and campaign structure — rebuilt for scale before a dollar of new spend goes live.

steps.title: Launch
steps.description: Campaigns go live with disciplined testing. Weekly reporting in plain English: spend, revenue, ROAS. No vanity metrics.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: Winners get budget. Losers get cut. We compound what works across paid media and email/SMS until growth is boring and predictable.

items.title: A small dinner table
items.description: We keep the client roster deliberately short. Your account is handled directly by a founder or partner — the people on the sales call are the people running your spend.

items.title: Revenue, not reports
items.description: We're judged on ROAS and gross sales — the same numbers you're judged on. If we don't move them, fire us.

items.title: No long contracts
items.description: Month-to-month. We keep clients by performing, not by locking them in.

items.title: Full-stack growth
items.description: Paid media, email/SMS, creative, and strategy under one roof — every channel feeding the next, every dollar accounted for. When one team owns the whole funnel, there's nobody to blame and nowhere to hide. We prefer it that way.

items.q: Who is Pace best suited for?
items.a: We'll work with anyone — all we ask for is full commitment and trust. Growth is a partnership, not a hand-off. Our specialty is e-commerce: apparel, streetwear, and DTC brands that live and die by drops, ROAS, and repeat customers.

items.q: What makes Pace different from other agencies?
items.a: The small dinner table. Your account is handled by a founder or partner — never passed down a chain of account managers — and our performance-based pricing means we only eat when you do.

items.q: What results can we realistically expect?
items.a: The bare minimum we expect is a 3.5 ROAS. We'll give you an honest range for your brand after the audit.

Performance-based, not flat retainers. Pricing scales with scope and ad spend, and our upside is tied to yours — when growth slows, we adjust. The audit call is free and you'll leave with value either way.
No. Everything is month-to-month. Our retention strategy is performance.

items.q: How quickly can we get started?
items.a: Audit within a week of the first call. Campaigns typically live within 2–3 weeks depending on creative and tracking setup.
